name: Rigidbody3D
signature: public sealed class Rigidbody3D : Component, ITransformChangeListener

docs.summary: World-space axes this body may not move or turn along during simulation. The body can still be placed on a frozen axis with [`MovePosition`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D~MovePosition) or [`MoveRotation`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D~MoveRotation).
How the Transform is filled in between fixed steps. Turn this on for anything the player watches closely; leave it off for bodies whose exact pose per frame does not matter.
How this body participates in the simulation: `Dynamic`, `Kinematic`, or `Static`.
Gets or sets whether continuous collision detection is enabled for this body.
Gets or sets a value indicating whether this Rigidbody3D is affected by gravity.
Gets or sets the mass of this Rigidbody3D.

Replaces the inertia worked out from the colliders with this diagonal, in the body's own space, in kg m^2, or null to work it out from the colliders. Heavier than the shapes give, a body turns more steadily, which a jointed chain of a light body and a heavy one needs.

Where the body's mass is centred, in metres along its own axes from its origin, or null for the origin itself. The body turns about this point and gravity pulls through it, while its colliders, its Transform and [`Position`](#api~Prowl.Scaffold.Position) stay where they are. Changing it on a moving body keeps the body's motion, and rebuilds the joints on it.
Gets or sets the friction of this Rigidbody3D.
Gets or sets the restitution of this Rigidbody3D.
Gets or sets the linear damping of this Rigidbody3D. The fraction of linear velocity removed every 1/60 s, whatever the fixed timestep. Range: 0 to 1.
Gets or sets the angular damping of this Rigidbody3D. The fraction of angular velocity removed every 1/60 s, whatever the fixed timestep. Range: 0 to 1.
Gets or sets whether gyroscopic forces are enabled for this Rigidbody3D. Useful for spinning objects with high inertia anisotropy (like propellers).
Gets or sets the deactivation time in seconds. The body sleeps if velocity stays below threshold for this duration.
Gets or sets the linear velocity threshold for sleeping.
Gets or sets the angular velocity threshold for sleeping (radians/second).
Gets whether this Rigidbody3D is currently active (not sleeping).
Gets or sets the Linear Velocity of this Rigidbody3D.
Gets or sets the Angular Velocity of this Rigidbody3D.
Where the simulation has the body right now. The Transform is interpolated between steps and trails this, so anything acting on the body at a point should measure from here.
The simulated orientation, without the interpolation the Transform shows. See [`Position`](#api~Prowl.Scaffold.Position).
Gets or sets the Torque of this Rigidbody3D.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.

members.name: AddForce
members.signature: public void AddForce(Float3 force, ForceMode mode = ForceMode.Force)

docs.summary: Applies a force through the body's centre of mass, so it accelerates without spinning.

members.name: AddForceAtPosition
members.signature: public void AddForceAtPosition(Float3 force, Float3 worldPosition, ForceMode mode = ForceMode.Force)

docs.summary: Applies a force at a world-space point, which also spins the body about its centre of mass. Only [`Force`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ForceMode~Force) and [`Impulse`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ForceMode~Impulse) are meaningful here; the mass-independent modes have no defined torque.

members.name: AddTorque
members.signature: public void AddTorque(Float3 torque, ForceMode mode = ForceMode.Force)

docs.summary: Applies a torque about the body's centre of mass.
Sets the activation state of this rigidbody (awake or sleeping).
Gets the velocity at a world space point on this rigidbody.

The centre of mass in world space, derived from the attached shapes and their offsets.

This is not the point the body spins about, which is its origin, or [`CenterOfMassOverride`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D~CenterOfMassOverride) when set. Setting that to this point, moved into the body's space, makes the body turn the way its shapes weigh. Shapes with no volume (a concave MeshCollider's triangles) contribute nothing, and a body made only of those reports its origin.

The diagonal of this body's inertia tensor in body space, in kg*m^2. Only the moments about the body's own axes; a shape whose principal axes are rotated relative to the body also has off-diagonal terms that this does not report.

members.signature: public void ApplyImpulse(Float3 impulse, Float3 worldPosition)

docs.summary: Applies an impulse at a position, immediately affecting velocity.
Applies an impulse to the rigidbody, immediately affecting velocity.
Applies an angular impulse to the rigidbody, immediately affecting angular velocity.
Moves the rigidbody to a new position (teleport).
Rotates the rigidbody to a new rotation about its origin (teleport).
